title: tx_queue_stats_get lacks locking despite header claiming thread-safety
description:
File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tx_queue.c
Line: 427

Header claims 'Thread-safe atomic copy under lock (no longer non-atomic)' but implementation performs `*stats = queue->stats;` without holding the lock. The 24-byte struct copy is not atomic; concurrent push/pop can cause torn reads. Either add lock_queue/unlock_queue calls, or correct the header documentation.
close_reason: Added lock_queue/unlock_queue calls around stats copy in tx_queue_stats_get to match header's thread-safety claim. Tests pass.
